title: How we triage timezone bugs
body: All datetime issues start by checking if the server is running in UTC. We never store local time. Reproductions must include the user's IANA timezone string.

title: Memory leak playbook
body: Take a heap snapshot before and after the suspected leak. Look for retained Buffer objects in the queue consumer — most leaks since 2024 have been there.

title: Worker concurrency model
body: Workers are stateless and safe to run in parallel against the same queue. The consumer group ID is read from QUEUE_GROUP env var; default is 'default'.

title: Cold-start budget
body: The CLI cold-start budget is 1.5 seconds. Anything beyond that is a perf issue. The dominant cost is the require graph; lazy-load any large SDK module.

title: Deprecation policy
body: We deprecate old API signatures one minor version before removal. The deprecation must include a console.warn pointing to the new signature.

title: Issue label taxonomy
body: Bug = unintended behavior in shipped code. Feature = new capability requested. Question = usage clarification. Docs = documentation gap. Perf = measurable speed/memory issue. When ambiguous, prefer the more specific label.

title: Retry policy defaults
body: Default retry policy is 3 attempts with 100ms initial backoff and 2x exponential factor. Override via the `retry` option in the client constructor.

title: Where to put API keys in CI
body: API keys for CI go in the repo's GitHub Actions secrets, never in committed files. Use the action `aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials` to surface them as env vars.

title: Image upload architecture
body: Image uploads >50MB must use the chunked endpoint. The merge step streams chunks to S3 — we never load full files in memory.

title: Why we don't accept Lambda PRs
body: Lambda support is community-maintained. We don't ship a SAM/serverless template; users have built their own and we link to them in DISCUSSIONS.
